title: CI build times are 3x slower since adding security scan
body:
## Performance: CI Pipeline Slowdown

Since the security-scan job was added, CI times went from ~3 min to ~9 min. This blocks rapid iteration for all contributors.

### Root Cause
Snyk and Trivy download full vulnerability databases on every run. No caching is configured.

### Proposed Fix
Add caching for scanner databases and parallelize scans with tests. I've prepared the config changes.

/cc @jordan-lee

comments.body:
I tested the caching approach locally and it cuts scan time from 4 min to 45 seconds. The main wins are persisting the Snyk and Trivy vulnerability databases across runs and adding a cache warm step.

I can share the full config if you'd like to review it — let me know if you want me to post it here or put up a PR.
